## Results

### Experiment A

Each `---` starts a new slide, and the heading chain above is repeated onto it.

---

Written with no headings at all: both `## Results` and `### Experiment A` were repeated here.

---

### Experiment B

A heading at this level starts a new chain under the same section, so only the parent is repeated.

## Limiting the depth {cascade-depth="1"}

### A subsection

---

Only `## Limiting the depth` was repeated; `cascade-depth` limited the chain.

## Opting out {.no-cascade}

### A subsection

---

Only `### A subsection` was repeated, because the heading above carries `.no-cascade`.

## More

Set `depth` under `extensions.cascade` for a document-wide limit, and `keep-hrule` to keep `---` in formats other than Reveal.js.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-revealjs-cascade/>.
